ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across the macro-level surface with localized high-intensity (white) mottle clusters representing approximately <5% of the surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-pigmented surface across both lobes; distinct high-contrast white mottling localized at the far left distal tip and sparse white pixel clusters along the medial trailing edge of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Defined V-shaped central depression with an acute pixel angle and high vertical depth relative to the horizontal width of the notch throat.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern; right lobe exhibits high-amplitude jagged peaks and deep valleys between the median notch and distal tip; left lobe displays moderate-frequency, lower-amplitude variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature on the trailing edges with a steep upward sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible clusters of high-contrast, raised circular pixel patterns at the extreme distal margins of both the left and right fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue voids and jagged indentations along the right lobe trailing edge suggest historical mechanical trauma or predation marks.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced accumulation of protruding, high-relief textures (barnacles) concentrated along the outer vertical boundary of the right fluke tip.
